notes.title: Explore ELDEN RING with new narrated preview video and pre-order now.
notes.content:
[h2]Experience a first-look at narrated ELDEN RING gameplay giving players a deep-dive into the following areas of the game:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Vast world design [/b]– the meticulously designed ”Lands Between” brings unprecedented immersion to FromSoftware’s largest game to date. Secrets hide around every corner of this immense world encouraging exploration for those who dare venture off the beaten path.
[*] [b]Legacy Dungeons[/b] – Large multi-level dungeons evoking classic FromSoftware level design are integrated into the overworld.
[*] [b]Traversal[/b] – Ride like the wind across The Lands Between on your Spectral Steed, and even engage in combat while on horseback.
[*] [b]Combat[/b] – Players can engage with a variety of basic or advanced combat options across a number of weapon types and magical disciplines.
[*] [b]Multiplayer[/b] – Team up with friends and help other Tarnished take down powerful foes with co-op multiplayer.
[/list]

[h2]Pre-order ELDEN RING today to gain access to following items:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Digital Adventure Guide[/b], containing useful information to help players as they enter The Lands Between.
[*][b]Bonus Gesture ‘The Ring’[/b] – Receive a gesture at the start of the game. [i]*Gesture can also be obtained in-game.[/i]
[/list]

Adventure and danger await any Tarnished daring enough to enter The Lands Between and attempt to claim themselves The Elden Lord starting on February 25, 2022.

[previewyoutube=JldMvQMO_5U;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245620/ELDEN_RING/
